gen-dafont-visitor-archivo: Pixel-pure nostalgia up top, with Visitor's wide-mouthed e and stubby ascenders over big bowls. And Archivo, a plain sans with a commanding x-height, settles in beneath it, curves opening outward and feeling friendly against all that digital edge.
gen-dafont-visitor-fs-asap: Nostalgic and digital, Visitor draws its strokes with no thick-thin pulse at all, just short ascenders over big bowls. And Asap, a sans with a body height nearly matching its capitals, gives that retro-screen look a readable, grounded partner.
gen-dafont-galaxy-general-sans: Galaxy's uninterrupted line width and dense, tall lowercase give it a cosmic, commanding look with plenty of loose breathing space. General Sans, a sans-serif with a filled-out x-height, moves smoothly around every bend.
gen-dafont-groovy-fs-epilogue: Epilogue reads curvy and unclamped, with stubby ascenders. Groovy, its funky partner, nearly shuts the c into a narrow slit and spaces its lowercase loosely, so the open, wire-like body feels like a relaxed exhale beside it.
gen-dafont-minecraftia-switzer: Minecraftia ticks along one character per beat, its towering lowercase leaving wide gaps between curve ends and stems, familiar and fun. Switzer's tubular, wire-like sans letters are the sharp contrast.
gen-dafont-nasalization-manrope: Nasalization floats its big lowercase letters well apart, with short ascenders and a c opened like calipers. Its job is friendly display character, while Manrope, a sans-serif with bright open curve mouths and one steady pen width, handles the quiet work of carrying text.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-epilogue: Epilogue is a plain sans with curvy, unclamped letters and a wire-like monoline skeleton, tall-bodied with stubby ascender tips. And Neuropolitical does the showy part, pulling words apart into glowing neon-tube letters with big open counters.
gen-dafont-nordic-fs-supreme: Nordic spaces its monoweight letters like brush dabs set far apart, powerful and ancient, with cramped openings. And Supreme, a sans-serif with a heavy-looking strip of text through the middle, would carry a longer passage crisply, its letters held open.
gen-dafont-nulshock-fs-public-sans: Stretched, spacious tracking and a steady, unshaded outline make Nulshock feel technical and bold from the first glance. Public Sans, a sans with a hefty lowercase and broad open counters on c and s, would read in a trustworthy, solid way over a longer passage.
gen-dafont-origami-satoshi: Satoshi reads tall and approachable, with a soaring x-height and a wide-open e that never looks squeezed shut. Origami's sign-painter brush strokes and poured-lead lowercase mass give it a unique, contemporary punch.
